scope: Read-only AST extraction of current_refresh_locked/read_cache/storage_target/cache_path/write_cache/parse methods; no imports, product mutation or workloads.
justification: Current_refresh_locked performs sorted per-file_read_cache calls serially. Observed cache wall is much greater than caller CPU, and valid matched full SDK comparisons support the current cold regression. Overlapping blocking derived-cache reads is a concrete cost-reduction hypothesis distinct from unsupported reader/publisher fallback.
No speedup, source-cause explanation or Master53 closure is inferred before implementation and qualification.
recommended_minimal_design: Keep original project FileLock owned by the main thread throughout discovery/read/parse/write/assembly/publication and join. Worker_read_cache must not acquire/release that lock or invoke source/Git/parser/writer code.

For repositories above the predeclared threshold only, use fixed<=4worker/<=4pending per-chunk reads with deterministic sorted main-thread consumption. No persistent model cache, freshness/stat shortcuts, entire-repository future list or unbounded executor backlog.

Within each chunk, submit only first occurrence of each(parser_kind,content_hash)key; resolve later duplicate keys serially after earlier results are parsed/written. This preserves one_read_cache call per path and canonical duplicate hit/miss behavior without prefetched stale-miss rereads.
All original_parse,_write_cache,metrics,additionally_parsed and graph assembly/publication remain serial and use unchanged returned model validation/version/hash/native snapshot/path guards.

Join/cancel-and-drain pending workers before graph publication, before an exception leaves the lock scope and before SDK close; preserve original primary failure and do not publish partial graph/manifest on error.
Small corpus below threshold retains original serial dispatch and injected service semantics. Worker read side effects/instrumentation must be accounted for explicitly.
rejected_shortcut: A prefetched duplicate miss followed by reread can restore serial hit/miss counts but adds duplicate native reads for corrupted cache keys. Avoid that extra work/observer ambiguity with per-chunk duplicate scheduling rather than describing it as original reads once.
required_acceptance_tests: Exact graph/manifest payload and hit/miss/processed/changed paths parity with serial reference across cold empty cache, all hits, mixed valid/corrupt/version/hash/kind-invalid caches, duplicate same-key sources and deletions. Ignore only preexisting clock/timestamp nondeterminism explicitly.

Deterministic completion inversions and blocked workers: sorted consumption/parse/write order identical, at most4submitted/live unfinished/results held; no all-file preload. Bound checks must observe actual submission, not just executor_max_workers.
Missing and corrupt duplicate keys observe earlier main-thread cache publication exactly once per source read; within-chunk and cross-chunk cases.
Unexpected worker/storage-policy error preserves primary, drains all workers and prevents graph/manifest/cursor publication before return; main project lock is not released while a worker is active.
Original missing source/source-content mutation conflict, link/junction/reparse containment and malformed cache guards still apply in threaded path; workers perform derived reads only.
Threshold boundary63/64(or final exactthreshold) and small injected/test repos preserve serial behavior; >=64path exercises real two-worker overlap without timing-speed assertions.

ReadProbe/logical I/O/resource measurements include worker-thread reads with safe accounting. Caller-thread CPU and previous owner-thread-only phase diagnostics cannot silently stand for aggregate worker cost.

Fresh focused/statics/contracts/artifacts/currentheldout and two unchanged full qualification iterations on new frozen source/tests/helpers; all original gold/budgets/baseline observations retained. Constrained resource gates must expose additional thread/queued-model overhead.
publication_boundary: No unseen implementation approved. Any source change retires source01 captures as historical; no acceptance reuse that rebinds old timings to new source.
